title: Casino Exit
summary: Review job fit, prepare source-backed applications, and follow assisted application progress from iPhone and iPad.
oneLiner: A job-search companion that keeps application preparation and approval in one place.

assets.label: Today with saved opportunities and application status
A fictional iOS engineering role with fit and review actions
Application preparation and tracking with a sample employer

caseStudy.problem: Job details, resume evidence and application status are usually scattered across job boards and local files.
caseStudy.role: I built the native companion, Notion-backed workflow, and application runners for Mac and Raspberry Pi.
decisions: Require review of the exact form before the final submission action.
Track an unconfirmed attempt separately from a confirmed receipt.
validation: Hosted form preparation and resume preview were exercised on an iPhone with the Mac offline. Automated tests use local employer-form fixtures.
limitations: Workday has an assisted runner. Greenhouse and Ashby use a hosted handoff where eligible. Employer sign-in and security checks can require manual steps.
